dedupe_keys.name: department of information technologies telecommunications datasets

description: Department of Information Technologies: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Department of Information Technologies. Coverage: Department of Information Technologies. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Daily Number of Distinc Users in IMM WiFi Points; The Number of Users of IMM Wifi Locations by Year; VDYM İlçe Bazında Hanelerin Ev İnternetine Dair Memnuniyet Dereceleri; IMM WiFi Location Data. Formats seen: CSV, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
